text: On the Berlin U-Bahn, a man in a metallic mask [hands out free tickets|trigger|saying yes to an offer] to a screening at the newly renovated Metropol cinema. On screen, teenagers dig up the empty grave of Nostradamus and find a mask, while in the lobby a prostitute named Rosemary scratches her face on [its twin|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. She becomes a red-eyed demon, [the infection spreads from seat to seat|wants|spreading and taking over], and the audience discovers [the exits have been bricked up|rules|trapped with no way out].
